summary: Thirteen MatchStrategy values (including NOT_EQUAL), six hit policies, dimension roles, six DataType values, and typed sentinel lookup helpers shared by metadata and both engine implementations.
extension_points: A new match strategy needs a constant plus matching dimension validation and compiler behavior.
lifecycle_notes: String, numeric, date and datetime sentinels distinguish rule-side unknown from context-side missing values.
DataType.BOOL falls through to string sentinel helpers; actual boolean null handling belongs to the compiler and context extraction, not a separate boolean sentinel constant.
documentation_hooks: Document all 13 strategies, including NOT_EQUAL; the prior profile incorrectly counted 12.
risks: Reserved sentinel values cannot simultaneously be ordinary domain values with distinct semantics.

evidence.detail: MatchStrategy has 13 declarations, including EXACT_KEY and NOT_EQUAL; sentinel helpers branch on numeric/date/datetime types.
Quick Start, Match Strategies and Serialisable Metadata provide concrete examples for a non-specialist capability overview; no performance or deployment guarantees inferred.
